# The Templates and Photos sheets end with a From a file... tile in Rust (2.2, #146), and the Templates sheet also
# ends with From a notebook... (2.2, #195): the empty sheets and the filled page's tiles. Rust's grid is the paper
# picker's 18 a page, so the filled page's waiting tiles, their dirty region and the page after a turn are Rust's
# own. Only these reviewed pixels differ; the page counts and every result keep the C baseline.
# The tiles' labels are drawn in each language, so a language's empty-sheet lines follow its "From a file...": when
# that translation changes, look at the 16 sheets again and record their lines (the ja lines were, when #136
# translated it; the empty sheets were recorded again for #195's tiles and 18-a-page grid, and every Classic line
# for 2.3's Classic, #209: rounder corners, and no rule under a sheet's title).
